about_the_game:
In Smash Out Colony Demo Version, try out 4 hammer, 5 skills, and 15 tools to change up your playstyle! 

Please note:

  • Demo version will save between plays, but will not carry over to the full version of the game. 

  • Full version will contain 10+ hammers, 10+ skills, and 50+ tools!

Smash Out Colony is a breakout-inspired horde survival game where timing is everything. Swing your hammer to deflect ricocheting projectiles, crush waves of enemies, and survive escalating chaos. With randomized upgrades, unique hammer types, and physics-driven mayhem, every run is a new challenge.

Spin-off to the award-winning Cast Out Colony, this fast-paced action game delivers tight mechanics, brutal enemy waves, and just enough unpredictability to keep you on your toes. You'll also see some familiar faces along the way!

Key Features

  • Deflect to survive – Bounce projectiles into swarming enemies using perfectly timed hammer swings.

  • Unique hammers – Choose from a variety of hammers, each with distinct stats.

  • Upgrade and adapt – Pick from randomized upgrades to build your own survival strategy.

  • Relentless action – Face increasingly difficult enemies and intense boss fights.

  • Physics-based combat – Ricocheting projectiles keep every moment dynamic and skill-based.

  • Replayability – Randomized upgrades and varied enemy spawns keep each session fresh.
